Container.Name: pictaria
Container.Overview: Pictaria Server is self-hosted photo intelligence, enrichment, curation, and automation for your Immich library. Explore your collection, optionally enrich it with AI, review your best photos, build Smart Albums that stay current, and pair it with Pictaria Frame.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Immich photo AI enrichment curation smart albums frame
Container.Requires: Immich 2.0 or newer, reachable from this container. When Immich runs on this Unraid server, use the server's LAN IP and Immich's published port rather than localhost. Immich Tags must be enabled for Pictaria's tag-backed features.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Pictaria web interface and API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Pictaria settings, databases, generated state, and built-in backups.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Immich URL reachable from this container, such as http://192.168.1.20:2283. Do not use localhost or include /api.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich API key for the account whose library Pictaria will use.

Config.Name: Pictaria Password
Config.Description: New password that protects the Pictaria web interface and API.
